$comment: The Bravo test, as a checklist the app shows over the map in test mode. Every step says what should happen BEFORE it is tried - that is the point. Two kinds: 'auto' steps are checked by tools/Get-TestStatus.ps1 and tick themselves (a person cannot tick them); 'manual' steps are things only a person in the cockpit can judge, and they tick them. 'when' limits a step to a kind of aircraft: any, piston, turboprop, jet. 'ifNot' is what a failure means and what to tell Mark. The order is the order to do them in.

steps.label: Bravo is plugged in
steps.expect: Ticks itself when the quadrant is seen on USB.
steps.ifNot: Plug it in. Nothing below can work without it.

steps.label: TO/GA button has been measured
steps.expect: Ticks itself once the capture tool has seen the TO/GA button pressed.
steps.ifNot: Run the capture command Mark gave you; it asks for one button. Until then TO/GA is left out of the map on purpose.

steps.label: Button map written into FSUIPC, including TO/GA
steps.expect: Ticks itself after 'Write and restart FSUIPC' below has run and the global [Buttons] section holds the full map.
steps.ifNot: Press 'Write and restart FSUIPC'. If it refuses, its message says why in plain words.

steps.label: No reverse-thrust lines left on piston aircraft
steps.expect: Ticks itself once the DA62 and Bonanza no longer carry a below-detent section. Pistons have no reversers; the first write gave them lines anyway.
steps.ifNot: Press 'Write and restart FSUIPC' - the rewrite removes them.

steps.label: FSUIPC is running and started AFTER the write
steps.expect: Ticks itself when FSUIPC7 is up and its start time is later than the settings file's last change. FSUIPC reads the file only at startup.
steps.ifNot: FSUIPC is either closed or still on the old file. 'Write and restart FSUIPC' handles both.

steps.label: FSUIPC accepted every button line
steps.expect: Ticks itself while the settings file carries no '<< ERROR' markers - FSUIPC appends one to any button line it rejects, so a bad line cannot hide.
steps.ifNot: A line was rejected. The overlay shows which; send it to Mark.

steps.label: Autopilot panel: HDG, NAV, APR, REV, ALT, VS, IAS, AUTOPILOT
steps.expect: Each button engages that mode - the annunciator on the panel changes. AUTOPILOT toggles the master.
steps.ifNot: A mode that does nothing on a default aircraft means that aircraft ignores the standard event. Note which button.

steps.label: Big knob follows the mode selector
steps.expect: With the selector on ALT the knob changes the altitude; on VS the vertical speed; on HDG the heading bug; on CRS the course; on IAS the speed.
steps.ifNot: Dead in ONE position only = that position's condition number is wrong. Note which.

steps.label: Gear lever
steps.expect: Up raises the gear, down lowers it, on aircraft that have retractable gear.
steps.ifNot: Backwards = swap two numbers. Note it.

steps.label: Trim wheel
steps.expect: One click per detent; forward is nose down, back is nose up.
steps.ifNot: Backwards = swap two numbers. Note it.

steps.label: Seven switches: battery, alternator, avionics, nav, beacon, strobe, taxi
steps.expect: ON at the position you called ON, OFF the other way, and the aircraft's switch follows yours exactly - the map sends the position, not a toggle.
steps.ifNot: One working backwards = its press and release are swapped. Note which switch.

steps.label: Flap handle
steps.expect: One notch per push; down is more flap.

steps.label: TO/GA button on lever 1
steps.expect: Arms take-off/go-around on aircraft that have it; on others, nothing visible.
steps.ifNot: Only a failure on an aircraft that shows TO/GA counts. Note the aircraft.

steps.label: Throttle levers below the detent = reverse thrust
steps.expect: Pulling a throttle lever below its detent engages reverse on that engine; bringing it back above cancels it. The sim state follows the lever.
steps.ifNot: Stuck in reverse after coming back up = the release line is not firing. Note which lever.

steps.label: Condition levers (5 and 6) below the detent = cut-off
steps.expect: Below the detent the aircraft's condition lever goes to CUT-OFF; back above it returns to LOW IDLE. This is the King Air's community preset path.
steps.ifNot: Moves but the wrong way, or not at all: note exactly what the cockpit lever did.

steps.label: Below the detent does nothing on this aircraft
steps.expect: Pulling a throttle lever below its detent changes nothing - pistons have no reversers, so no line is written for them.
steps.ifNot: If something DID happen, a stale section survived. Note it.
